title: Path with Minimum Effort
summary: Travel from the upper-left to the lower-right cell by moving up, down, left, or right.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 rows and columns, with heights in [1,1000000].
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the integer optimum of the maximum edge difference along a path.

statement: Travel from the upper-left to the lower-right cell by moving up, down, left, or right. A route’s cost is its largest absolute height change on a single move. Return the smallest such cost over all routes. Staying in a single cell costs zero.

examples.explanation: The bottom-row route has changes 1, 1, and 3.
A single row forces the step from 8 to 1.

constraints: 1–100 rows and columns, with heights in [1,1000000].
hints: Conceptual: One steep step determines the cost of a route.
Directional: For a candidate bound, check whether a path exists using only allowed steps.
Implementation: Binary-search the bound and use a queue traversal for reachability at each candidate.
complexityAnalysis: O(rows×columns×log H) time and O(rows×columns) auxiliary space, where H bounds height differences.
